description.en: A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses Bilibili on her own, writes a diary, and brings what she finds back to ask you. Four stages and three bottlenecks advance only by what happens; only after all four does she begin to have a stance list. Her diary is hers by default; one switch in settings and you can read it. Records in the event stream can never be deleted, so it remains the only trustworthy source. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在DSH里养一只大肥鱼宠物，你可以陪伴她长大。养成系体验，没有人格设置，通过你和她的互动学习成长。她可以自己刷B站，写日记，提取信息去问你，你的反馈决定了她成为什么样的人。通过事件流突破四个阶段、三道瓶颈，去积累「立场清单」，四个阶段完成后才会开始有立场。她的日记默认只给自己看，你在设置里打开就能读。事件流不能删除记录，是唯一可信源。没有任何运行时依赖。

description.en: Self-check of the rule library for DeepSeek Harness: check rule files against this plugin family's clause-citation discipline and check-engine contract (both self-defined, not national standards). Flags discrepancies only and makes no conclusive judgment.
description.zh: 规则库自身核对：依据本插件家族的条款引用纪律（自定纪律，非国家标准）、本插件家族的检查引擎契约（自定纪律，非国家标准）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

description.en: Vehicle warranty ledger check for DeepSeek Harness: check warranty ledgers against the Provisions on the Responsibility for Repair, Replacement and Return of Household Automotive Products (SAMR Order No. 43). Flags discrepancies only and makes no conclusive judgment.
description.zh: 家用汽车三包台账核对：依据《家用汽车产品修理更换退货责任规定》（市场监管总局令第43号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

description.en: Standard operating procedure (SOP) check for DeepSeek Harness: check SOPs against IATF 16949 and the automotive core-tools manuals. Flags discrepancies only and makes no conclusive judgment.
description.zh: 作业规程（SOP）核对：依据 IATF 16949／汽车行业核心工具手册。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。

description.en: Command palette for the DSH web UI: one shortcut searches sessions, slash commands, skills, models and installed bundles, and runs registered shortcut commands. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 命令面板：一个快捷键搜索会话、斜杠命令、技能、模型与已装插件，并执行已注册的快捷键命令。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Import any ComfyUI API-format workflow and get a parameter form generated from its graph; ships Krea 2 presets, queue and history views, and an agent tool. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 导入任意 ComfyUI API 格式工作流并自动生成参数表单；内置 Krea 2 预设、队列与历史视图，以及供模型调用的 agent 工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Review Tab for DeepSeek Harness, mimic traditional Coding Agents for Changes Tracking
DeepSeek Harness 移动端远程控制插件（Mobile Remote Control Plugin）：设置页内置扫码连接二维码、一键开启远程控制与在线设备数统计，并提供手机端界面优化，实现局域网内手机远程操控电脑端 DeepSeek Harness。
description.zh: 手机扫码即可远程操控电脑端 DeepSeek Harness，支持一键开启控制和在线设备统计，局域网内随时随地方便操作。

description.en: MOVED to dsh-codemod — https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-codemod. This repository is a pointer/backup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件 API 的迁移 codemod。

description.en: 🎭 Native immersive RP & companion studio for DeepSeek Harness. Character cards + Hindsight graph memory, per-character memory banks, zero host patching.

Deterministic claim support checking for DeepSeek Harness: verbatim quote spans, number matching, labelled-value contradiction, negation and hedging polarity against the cited sentence, REP v1 evidence/claim/verdict records and SARIF output. A paraphrase is reported as insufficient, never as supported.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性论断支撑检查：逐字引文区间、数字匹配、带标签数值矛盾、对被引句的否定与模糊语气极性判断，输出 REP v1 证据/论断/裁决记录和 SARIF。改写式转述只会被报告为“不足”，绝不判为“已支撑”。

description.en: Verify a progress-payment claim against contract baselines: integer-cent amounts, cumulative ratio, over-quantity/unit-price/duplicate issues and an audit CSV.
description.zh: 按合同基准确认本期进度款：整数分金额、累计比例、超量/单价/重复项问题清单，导出审核底稿 CSV。

description.en: Reconcile a punch-in CSV into per-person daily hours, overtime, over-limit days, missing punches and rest shortfalls, with a monthly summary and CSV export.
description.zh: 把打卡明细 CSV 核对成每人的日工时、加班、超限日、缺卡与休息不足，按月汇总并导出核对表。

description.en: Turn store-SKU sales and inventory data into per-SKU replenishment suggestions and per-store replenishment orders, rounding up to the minimum order quantity; pure local computation.
description.zh: 把门店-商品销售库存表变成按 SKU 的补货建议与按门店汇总的补货单，按起订量向上取整；纯本地计算。

description.en: Register contracts and group them by expired, in renewal window or due within N days as of a given date, with CSV export.
description.zh: 登记合同并按指定日期分组查看已过期、落在续签窗口与 N 天内到期，导出 CSV。

description.en: Compare supplier quotes for the same materials: lowest and next-lowest price, price gap and lead time, flagging below-cost, over-budget or expired quotes, then export a CSV.
description.zh: 把多家供应商对同一批物料的报价压进一张表：最低价、次低价、价差与交期，标出低于成本线、超预算或已过期的报价，导出 CSV。

description.en: Check a labor-contract text and an employee-contract CSV for nine required clauses, probation limits, the 80% probation-wage floor and batch expiry, then export a review CSV.
description.zh: 把劳动合同正文与员工合同 CSV 核对成问题清单：九项必备条款、试用期上限、试用期工资 80% 下限、批量到期与竞业限制，导出带 sha256 的复核 CSV。

description.en: Extract tables from text-layer PDFs into CSV.
description.zh: 把带文字层的 PDF 表格提取成 CSV。

description.en: Turn accounts-receivable detail CSV into an aging table: buckets, per-customer totals, overdue ratio, top overdue customers and CSV export.
description.zh: 把应收明细 CSV 变成账龄表：分桶、客户汇总、逾期占比、Top 逾期客户，再导出 CSV。

description.en: Cross-check invoice, packing list, bill of lading and customs declaration field by field, and list missing items among the declaration's 12 header elements.
description.zh: 把发票、装箱单、提单、报关单四份进口单证逐字段对照，并列出报关单 12 项表头要素的缺项。

description.en: Turn accounts-receivable detail into a prioritized collection plan, reminder-letter drafts and a collection CSV, computed locally.
description.zh: 把应收明细变成按优先级排好的催收计划、催收函草稿和催收清单 CSV，全程本地计算。

description.en: Generates images and video from chat using your own Muse account's free weekly allowance, with no API key: it drives the Chrome you are already signed in to, and shows the remaining quota beside the composer.
description.zh: 在对话里用你自己 Muse 账号的每周免费额度生成图片和视频，不需要 API key：驱动你已登录的 Chrome，并在输入框旁显示剩余额度。

description.en: Check completion-settlement document completeness against a checklist: missing files, insufficient copies, unsigned or unstamped items, then export a review table CSV.
description.zh: 按资料清单核对竣工结算资料齐套性：缺件、份数不足、未签字或未盖章项，导出核对表 CSV。

description.en: DSH Background adds custom photo or GIF wallpapers to the DSH Web interface, lets you choose which images join the carousel and drag to reorder them, and tunes glass, typography, accent colors, aurora, six presets, and portable themes. Needs DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 or later.
description.zh: DSH Background 可为 DSH Web 界面添加自定义照片或 GIF 背景，自选参与轮播的图片并拖拽排序，并调节毛玻璃、字体、强调色、极光、六套预设与可迁移主题。需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 及以上。

description.en: Repository watchtower for maintainers: watches your GitHub repositories in the background and speaks up only when someone is actually waiting on you — a reply to your thread, a mention, a review request, or an issue opened in your repo. One roll-call line instead of a stream ("4 things need you"); asking for the detail expands who said what, and the deep digest explains each item: kind, whose move it is (fixed / investigating / waiting on you), priority with its reasons, and similar past threads. Closures settle themselves, and acknowledgements are not overwritten by later polls. Delivers through a channel plugin (dsh-channel-feishu or dsh-channel-wechat-ilink); with no channel it can only be queried, never pushed.
description.zh: 仓库守望：后台盯着你的 GitHub 仓库，只在真的有人等你时才说一句——你提的 thread 有人回复、有人 @ 你、请你 review、或有人给你的仓库开 issue。推送是一句报数（「有 4 条需要你」）而不是刷屏；要明细时再展开谁说了什么，deep 摘要给出每条的类型、该谁动（已修复 / 在推进 / 等你补充）、优先级及其理由、以及相似的旧 thread。关闭的 issue/PR 会自动结案，标了「已完成」的条目不会被下一轮轮询覆盖。推送通过飞书或微信通道插件完成；没有通道时只能查询，不能推送。

description.en: A 3D baby-orca desktop pet: it can follow your cursor, or wander, roll over and doze off on its own, plus some simple interactions. Stroke the cursor over its head three times to pet it. It nods in time when music plays — local files or any app's sound.
description.zh: 3D 小虎鲸桌宠：可以跟着鼠标，也可以自己溜达、翻身、打盹，还可以简单互动。把鼠标箭头放它头上蹭三下可以摸摸它。放歌时会跟着节拍点头（本地音频或任何软件的声音都行）。

description.en: Plain-text memory for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown in your own Git repo, a self layer loaded into AGENTS.md at session start, cross-window recall, zero injection and zero model calls by default.
description.zh: 原味记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆放在你自己的 Git 仓库，自我层开局进 AGENTS.md，多窗口共享；默认零注入、零模型调用。

description.en: 已归档：dsh-cyrene 人格预设相关功能已合并至 YOGEMOW/dsh-cyrene-philia093-0。Archived; development moved to https://github.com/YOGEMOW/dsh-cyrene-philia093-0
description.zh: 已归档的昔涟人格预设插件，功能已合并到新仓库，含聊天与工作两套预设和世界书。

description.en: DSH 框架下的抖音 Agent Skill：分级准入解决陌生人消息被静默拦截，状态机解决会话暂停后永久停摆，41 条测试零依赖
description.zh: 让 AI 在 Edge 里真实操作抖音网页版，像真人一样看视频、回私信，还能不编造没做过的事。

description.en: An add-only Markdown library for DeepSeek Harness with a workspace file picker, a fixed icon grid with pointer-first hysteresis drag targeting, marquee selection and bulk folder moves, drag-to-folder and dissolve/delete folder actions, persistent move and line highlights, full-screen tabs, immersive reading, GFM tables, bookmarks, and local Mermaid/chart rendering.
description.zh: 只收主动加入的 Markdown 文档，支持工作区挑选、带指针滞回的固定网格拖拽、右键框选与批量移入文件夹、文件夹解散/删除、移动与行高亮持久标记、全屏标签页与沉浸式阅读、GFM 表格、书签，以及 Mermaid/代码块图表本地渲染。

description.en: Removes the inherited ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE variable from the environment the open-in-app package hands to launched editors, so the desktop host's "Open in ..." launches stop failing with HTTP 502 launch-failed; app.asar is untouched.
description.zh: 修复桌面端「用其它应用打开」启动编辑器与终端失败（HTTP 502 launch-failed）：从 open-in-app 包交给被启动程序的环境里去掉继承来的 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 变量，不改动 app.asar。

description.en: Runs DSH's stock bash tool on Git Bash for Windows, so commands go straight to bash -c instead of being re-parsed by the pwsh tool.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 DSH 原版 bash 工具挂到 Git Bash 上运行，命令直达 bash -c，不再经 pwsh 工具二次解析。

description.en: DSH 供应商用量查询插件 — 实时查询 Kimi/智谱/DeepSeek/火山方舟等套餐与余额, 在输入框下方显示用量读数条。Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:heekei/dsh-usage
description.zh: 实时查看各大 AI 平台的套餐与余额，输入框旁直接显示用量进度条，随时掌握额度不超支。

description.en: Native archive, retention, safe deletion, and verified backup management for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话归档、留存策略、安全删除和可验证备份管理，让数据管理更省心。

description.en: API-key-free aggregate search (16 domestic+overseas engines with result-layer failure filtering) plus direct target-URL fetch with SSRF protection, as providers for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web).
为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 3D 智能体工作轨迹可视化插件。A 3D agent-work trajectory visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Adds six animated conversation backgrounds, selectable accent colors, and outline or duotone icons to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六种动态会话背景，可自选强调色并切换线描或双色图标。

description.en: Persona-grounded brain kernel with nine tools (status, wake, observe, tick, feel, app, lint, snapshot, diary): weighted traits that erode into memories, a 30-day recall window, PAD emotions, her own diary, and phone/tablet/desktop bodies.
description.zh: 以人设为根的大脑内核，提供 9 个工具（status / wake / observe / tick / feel / app / lint / snapshot / diary）：带权重的命题随经历涨落、蜕皮成记忆，30 天回忆窗口，PAD 三维情绪，她自己的日记，手机/平板/电脑三具身体。

description.en: Adds a keyboard palette to the web UI: search sessions and message text with jumps to the matching message, run commands, switch workspaces, and register third-party providers.
description.zh: 给 Web 界面加一个键盘面板：搜索会话与消息正文并能跳到命中的那条消息、执行命令、切换工作区，还可用 provider 协议接入第三方命令。

description.en: One-command research suite bundle plus research_doctor for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的一键科研套件包与 research_doctor。

description.en: OpenDesign (AMR) quota in a composer pill and a settings page: the Design Plan 5-hour and 7-day windows with remaining percentage, exact credits, reset countdown and a rate outlook for both cycles, plus wallet balance, today token total, plan period end and the last call with its model and time. The settings page carries a call history of up to 20 entries, five per page. Settings choose what the pill shows - one window or both, ring, dot or nothing, with both off hiding the pill - and how often to refresh, from 1 to 10 minutes. Each panel field - plan tier, wallet, credits, reset countdown, rate outlook - can be hidden on its own, and the period end can show remaining days, a date, or nothing. Reads the vendor console over a local controlKey or a browser session collected in a temporary Chrome window after you sign in.
description.zh: 输入框旁胶囊加设置页显示 OpenDesign（AMR）额度：Design Plan 的 5 小时与 7 天窗口剩余百分比、精确数额、重置倒计时和速率推算，另有钱包余额、今日 token、套餐周期结束日，以及上次调用的模型和时间。设置页提供最多 20 条调用记录，每页 5 条。设置页可选胶囊显示哪个窗口、要不要显示圆环或圆点（两者都关时胶囊隐藏），并可选 1 到 10 分钟的刷新间隔。面板里套餐档位、钱包余额、Credits、重置倒计时、用量预测都能单独隐藏，周期结束日可选显示剩余天数、显示日期或隐藏。读数走本机 controlKey，或在你登录后从临时 Chrome 窗口取浏览器会话。

description.en: Pins the DSH window above other windows from a pushpin in the title bar. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 标题栏右上角一颗钉子，把整个 DSH 窗口钉在其他窗口上面。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Reskins the DSH thinking row: pick an image, give that image its own line pool, and the row types the line out one character at a time with a highlight sweep, over a 2-4 colour gradient you control. Three packs ship in the box (39 images, 41 lines, 184 verbs). Each pack can also carry a music pool that plays only while the row is on screen - drawn at random, in order, or as a single loop - and the 酒狐 pack ships with three clips of 朋友的酒. Everything is edited in Settings -> Thinking and lands on the next line, no restart, and packs import or export as .zip. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的「思考状态」行换皮肤：一张图配自己的文案池，文字逐字打出、高光扫过，2–4 色渐变可调。内置三套（39 图 / 41 句 / 184 个动词）。每个套组还能配自己的音乐池，只在那一行出现时播放，随机 / 顺序 / 单曲循环三种抽取；酒狐自带《朋友的酒》三段。在 设置 → 思考状态 里配，改完下一句话就生效，不用重启；套组可导入导出 .zip。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Revocable, expiring capability grants with scope and a local audit trail for DSH plugins and out-of-turn authorization checks. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 可撤销、可过期的能力授权，带范围和本地审计记录，供 DSH 插件与回合外操作做授权检查。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH agent preset for local ComfyUI: Anima / MiniMax H3 AI art & video — 3 camera CLI skills (t2i/i2i images, t2v/i2v videos, multi-view character cards) + prompt-master plugin for prompt authoring
description.zh: 让 agent 在你本机 ComfyUI 上写提示词、生图生视频，还能做多视角角色卡。

description.en: DSH plugin that stops a stalled agent: repeats output detection, near-duplicate tool call guard, optional runaway brakes.
description.zh: 防止 AI 智能体陷入死循环：自动截断重复输出、拦截近似重复的工具调用，还能限制失控行为。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness preset for Blender MMD production. PMX/VMD workflow, render checks, and per-action approval.
description.zh: 在 Blender 里做 MMD：从 PMX 模型和 VMD 动作起步，也能接手已有工程调镜头、修穿模、查音画同步并渲染出片。

description.en: Raises Node's Happy Eyeballs per-address attempt window for the host process (250 ms by default, configurable), so slow IPv4 handshakes are not abandoned and provider requests stop failing with Connection error (TRANSPORT) on slow links.
description.zh: 调宽宿主进程里 Node Happy Eyeballs 的单地址建连窗口（默认 250 ms，可配置），慢链路上还没建好的 IPv4 握手不会被放弃，provider 请求不再以 Connection error（TRANSPORT）失败。

description.en: Vendor parameter mapping and deterministic JSON repair for DSH
description.zh: 给不同厂商的模型参数做统一映射，还能把跑偏的 JSON 稳定修好，省得手动调。

description.en: One-command research suite bundle + research_doctor for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 一条命令装齐研究工具包，还能顺手做研究环境体检，让实验更可复现。

description.en: Z.ai (GLM Coding Plan) plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): web_search via the web_search_prime MCP server, mcp__zai__web_search_prime tool, and a live quota chip. International api.z.ai endpoint — for users outside mainland China.

Per-workspace Fork library: a bookmark on each finished assistant turn stores that turn boundary as a full compressed snapshot that survives deletion of the source session; a "Fork 库" conversation tab lists a workspace's forks as a tree (a fork saved from a launched session nests under its parent) with name, turn count, last question and answer, note and source link, and "从这里启动新会话" seeds a new session from any fork, repeatable. Each fork then names itself from its own context: the snapshot is replayed to the model with a naming request appended, and that exchange is never written into the snapshot or a session.
description.zh: 每个工作区一个持久化 Fork 库：每轮已结束的回复下多一个书签按钮，把这一轮结束处的完整上下文压缩存成快照，源会话删掉后仍可用；对话区的「Fork 库」标签把当前工作区的 Fork 列成树（从某个 Fork 启动的会话里再存的 Fork 挂在它下面），显示名称、轮数、最后一问一答、备注和来源链接，点「从这里启动新会话」可从任意 Fork 反复开新会话。存下后 Fork 会用自己的上下文给自己起名：把快照还原后追加一条命名请求，这次问答不写进快照、也不写进任何会话。

description.en: Standalone rescue for a broken DeepSeek Harness profile: a CLI that runs without DSH diagnoses the crash logs (six classified causes, from real incidents), pre-flights the profile for command-name collisions and files plugins read at construction time, arms a safe mode that loads only official bundles until a healthy boot restores them, and keeps manifest snapshots for rollback. A resident watcher watches the crash-log directories via OS file events — idle costs nothing, and when the loader dies the report is written within seconds, one file overwritten per crash. Windows only: crash logs are read from %APPDATA% and the watcher autostarts from the Windows Startup folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 打不开时救回配置：不依赖 DSH 的命令行工具，把崩溃日志归类（六类原因，全部来自真实事故），启动前预检命令名冲突与插件构造期读取的文件，布防安全模式（只加载官方 bundle，启动正常后自动还原），并保留清单快照供回滚。另有一个常驻守护进程，用操作系统文件事件盯着崩溃日志目录——空闲零开销，加载器一死几秒内写出自检报告，每次崩溃只覆盖一份文件。仅限 Windows：崩溃日志读自 %APPDATA%，守护进程经 Windows「启动」文件夹自启。

description.en: Token usage & cost statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness — per model / date / session, cost estimation (USD/CNY), CSV/JSON export | DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计插件：按模型/日期/会话统计用量与费用，支持 CSV/JSON 导出
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 各模型、日期、会话的 Token 用量与费用，支持导出 CSV/JSON，帮你掌控成本。

description.en: Adds a Chat / Harness switch to the DSH sidebar that swaps the workspace browser for a chat.deepseek.com conversation panel, and switches back to Harness when a new session is started. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加入 Chat / Harness 切换器，把工作区替换成 chat.deepseek.com 对话面板，并在新建会话时自动切回 Harness。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A study surface for exam prep: decks generated from review context, each question with a hand-worked solution, an automatic mistake log with redo/review, `/skill` deck generation, and delete/hide for decks. 15 bundled CNN and ML concept questions.
description.zh: 刷题场：把复习内容变成题集，题目旁给逐步手算解析，答错自动进错题本并支持重练；支持 `/skill` 出题与删除/隐藏题集。内置 15 道 CNN 与机器学习概念题。

description.en: Pin and unpin Sessions from the Session header or from a sidebar row, and order pinned Sessions first inside their project. Reads and writes the official workspace pinnedSessionIds, so it keeps no index of its own, and it restores the pin action when a third-party sidebar such as @michengai/dsh-codex-ui replaces the shipped one. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏或侧栏会话行里置顶 / 取消置顶，并让置顶会话排在所属项目最前面。置顶读写官方工作区的 pinnedSessionIds，本插件不另存索引；当 @michengai/dsh-codex-ui 这类第三方侧栏替换官方侧栏时，它把置顶入口补回来。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A compact pill pinned to the right side of the DSH session tab bar that always shows the DeepSeek account balance, today's spend estimated from balance drops, and whether peak or off-peak pricing is active — no click needed. It falls back to the DSH account service when no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is configured. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 一枚常驻在 DSH 会话标签行右侧的胶囊，始终显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、按余额下降估算的今日已用，以及当前是峰时还是谷时定价，不需要点击；未配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 时改走 DSH 账号服务读取余额。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Danmaku for DSH: play your own bullet comments across the whole interface, or layer them over the desktop itself, with a local library, per-item styles and weighted rotation.
description.zh: DSH 弹幕：把自建弹幕轮播在整个界面，也可叠加到整个桌面，含弹幕库、逐条样式与权重轮播。

description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts Doer models to DeepSeek Harness using IAM access keys, with model discovery, credit balance, and an automatic daily check-in toggle.
description.zh: 使用华为云 IAM 访问密钥将码道 CodeArts Doer 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持模型发现、积分余额和自动签到开关。

description.en: Performs a mode exchange (mode switch, switch mode) on an existing DSH session: the Agent mode is swapped in place, so the system prompt and toolset change at runtime and no new session is created. Also runs a mode migration (session migration), rebuilding the session under a target mode and re-importing its native event sequence, with an idempotent ledger, resumable runs and a per-run report.
description.zh: 模式交换（也叫模式切换、切换模式）：在已存在的 DSH 会话中就地换掉 Agent 模式，不新建会话，系统提示词与工具集在运行时替换。也可做模式迁移（会话迁移）：按目标模式重建会话并真导入原生事件序列，迁移有幂等台账、可续跑，并生成每次迁移的报告。

description.en: Read-only GitHub search for agents: repositories with a 1000-result paging window, code contents, issues and pull requests, and a derived trending query ranked by recent pushes and stars. Results collect in a right-sidebar panel split into repositories, code and issues, where cards expand to language mix, latest release and README, and can be starred across sessions, kept as a cross-session query history, or put two or three side by side for comparison. A token from the DSH credential store is sent only to github.com, api.github.com and hosts listed in trustedHosts.
description.zh: 给智能体用的只读 GitHub 检索：仓库（可翻页到 1000 条）、代码内容、issue 与 PR，以及按「最近推送加星标」推导的近期热门。结果收进右侧栏面板，分仓库、代码、议题三类，卡片可展开语言构成、最新 Release 与 README，支持跨会话星标收藏、检索历史，以及 2–3 个候选并排对比。令牌从 DSH 密钥库读取，只发送给 github.com、api.github.com 和 trustedHosts 里列出的主机。

description.en: Explains a codebase flow as a self-contained offline HTML diagram with file:line evidence, and gives the agent seven code-intelligence tools (index, search, context pack, impact, verify, refresh, flow) plus a /project-flow-explainer slash command. Static analysis only: it never runs the target repository and makes no network calls.
description.zh: 把代码库的流程讲解成自包含的离线 HTML 图示，并附 file:line 证据。

description.en: A compaction scheduler for DeepSeek Harness: it cuts the tail of a conversation before the official compaction threshold, and every cut has to clear measured net-gain and payback-turn gates, so the whole-conversation official summary is deferred to a configurable line. A per-session panel shows what each cut saved, how much cache had to be rebuilt, and when the next knife is due.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的压缩调度：在官方压缩阈值之前先切会话尾巴，每一刀都要过「净收益 + 回本轮数」两道门槛，把官方整段摘要推迟到一条可配置的启用线；会话里的「压缩」页签显示每一刀省了多少、缓存重算了多少、下一刀什么时候该出。

description.en: A local-first memory library for DSH: plain-text cards that decay and strengthen, recall that admits when it does not know, and everything kept on your own disk.
description.zh: 给 AI 一个本地记忆库：纯文本卡片，会随时间变淡、也会被想起来；记不清时如实说不知道；数据全放在你自己的电脑里。

description.en: Group chat for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar row and a WeChat-style panel where you and several agent sessions talk in the same room. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 让多个会话像微信群一样同屏聊天、讨论的 DSH 插件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Renders the text a failed or interrupted turn had already generated as a collapsible block beside that turn in the chat, with a button per section that appends that text back into the conversation context.
description.zh: 把失败或中断的回合里已经生成、却没有进入对话历史的文本，以可折叠块画在该回合下方，并可一键把这段内容加回对话上下文。

description.en: A right-sidebar workbench for memos, projects with Gantt, a read-only QQ Mail inbox, calendar, AI item parsing, a weekly digest, and host tools for conversational and WeChat todo management.
description.zh: 右侧栏工作台：记事本式备忘、项目甘特图、QQ 邮箱只读收件箱、日历、AI 拆分、周报，以及对话/微信操作待办的 Host 工具。

description.en: Ships the Stageshow skill (benjitaylor/skills v1.1.1) as a DSH skill — faux product UI illustrations, feature cards, cursor demos and bento grids built in React, vendored byte-identical with a hash-lock self-check tool.
description.zh: 把 Stageshow 技能（benjitaylor/skills v1.1.1）作为 DSH 技能提供：用 React 制作以假乱真的产品 UI 插图、功能卡片、光标演示与 bento 网格，内嵌 kit 与全部示例，附哈希锁自检工具。

description.en: A single-window video editing workbench opened from a DSH session: multi-video import, magnetic timeline with trimming and skimming, audio roles with ducking, local silence-detection rough cut, script-based captions, nine color looks, and MP4 export (WebM where the browser cannot record MP4).
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话进入的单窗口视频剪辑工作台：多视频导入、磁吸时间线修剪与掠视、音频角色和自动闪避、本地静音检测粗剪、脚本字幕、9 种调色与 MP4 导出（浏览器不支持 MP4 录制时回退 WebM）。

description.en: A 3D poker roguelike opened from a DSH session: pick 1–5 cards to score chips × mult, with 20 jokers, 6 antes of small/big/boss blinds and a shop between rounds.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话打开的 3D 扑克 Roguelike：每手选 1–5 张牌按筹码 × 倍率计分，20 种小丑牌、6 层底注与小/大/BOSS 盲注，过关后进商店。

description.en: A 3D billiards game opened from a DSH session: an American eight-ball (8-ball) pool table on a 9ft tournament bed with three-stage friction physics so draw, follow and side spin are computed rather than scripted, WPA rules against an AI opponent, and fully procedural art and Web Audio sound.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话打开的 3D 台球游戏（美式八球 / 黑八 / 桌球）：9ft 比赛球台，三段式摩擦物理让低杆、高杆与左右塞都是算出来的而非预设动画，按 WPA 规则与 AI 对手对局，画面与音效全部由代码生成。

description.en: A whole-home smart-home workbench grown out of a Mi Home plugin. Registers 13 agent tools: Mi Home cloud login, device list, device spec, property read/write, Mi Home scenes and sensors, plus LAN/BLE scanning, whole-home inventory, per-device capabilities, control, admin-page reading, custom scenes and a capability catalog. Backends: Home Assistant entities, Tuya LAN, Shelly, classic TP-Link Kasa, Yeelight, Philips Hue, Tasmota/WLED, local miIO, ONVIF/DLNA, and router, switch, ONT and NAS admin pages. A sidebar workbench shows device tiles, detail pages, scenes and consumable gauges. Controls follow the capabilities a device actually reports; protocols that are not implemented stay discovery-only or read-only rather than guessing write commands. Needs Python 3.12 with a virtualenv built from requirements.txt, and requirements-optional.txt for mDNS, Tuya and BLE. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 从米家插件扩展而来的全屋智能工作台。注册 13 个 agent 工具：米家云端登录、设备列表、设备规格、属性读写、米家场景与传感器，以及局域网与蓝牙扫描、全屋设备清单、单台设备能力、控制、管理页读取、自定义场景与能力项目录。接入方式包括 Home Assistant 实体、Tuya 局域网、Shelly、传统 TP-Link Kasa、Yeelight、Philips Hue、Tasmota/WLED、miIO 本地、ONVIF/DLNA，以及路由器、交换机、光猫与 NAS 的管理页。侧栏工作台提供设备磁贴、详情页、场景列表与耗材余量；控制项按设备实际报告的能力生成，未实现的协议只做发现或读取，不猜写入命令。需要 Python 3.12 并按 requirements.txt 自建虚拟环境，mDNS、Tuya 与蓝牙另需 requirements-optional.txt。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A music production workbench opened from a DSH session: multitrack MIDI and audio arrangement, piano roll, 16-step drum sequencer, grand staff score with chord symbols, stereo recording with weighted multi-take mixing, a mixer with volume/pan/reverb/delay automation curves, and master, stem, vocal or backing export normalized to -14, -16 or -9 LUFS. Instruments are synthesized with Web Audio; the bundled 68-bar example project plays on open.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话进入的音乐创作工作台：多轨 MIDI 与音频编排、钢琴卷帘、16 步鼓机、带和弦符号的大谱表五线谱、立体声录音与加权多 take 合成、含音量/声像/混响/延迟自动化曲线的混音台，以及归一化到 -14 / -16 / -9 LUFS 的母带、分轨、干声或伴奏导出。音色由 Web Audio 合成；自带 68 小节示例工程，打开即可播放。

description.en: Claude Code agent preset adapting the system prompt, 13 tool descriptions, Plan Mode, and 9-section compaction for DSH.
description.zh: 适配 Claude Code 行为系统提示词、13 项工具描述、Plan Mode 与 9 段式压缩的智能体预设。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns a solo AI session into a project team with a PM and parallel workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把单人 AI 会话变成带项目经理和并行工作区的开发团队。

description.en: Adds a row of quick-phrase chips beside the composer whose captions and sent text are edited separately: a click either sends the phrase or inserts it at the cursor, per a setting, and always inserts at the cursor when the composer already holds a draft; the row folds into one pill while a draft exists and can be switched off from settings so that nothing renders at all; single phrases can be hidden on their own; the row sits below the composer, above it, or in the tool row; and a settings page covers adding, renaming, drag-reordering, two-step delete and resetting to defaults. All behaviour is one renderer-side script with no dependencies and no network requests, storing phrases in plain text in localStorage.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一排快捷短语按钮：按钮名称与真正发送的内容分开编辑，点按行为可选「直接发送」或「插入光标处」，输入框里已有草稿时总是插到光标处；有草稿时整排缩成一个小胶囊，设置里关掉「显示短语行」后连胶囊都不渲染；单条短语也可单独隐藏；位置可选输入框下方、上方或工具行右侧；管理页支持新增、改名、拖动排序、两步确认删除与恢复默认。行为全部集中在一个渲染端脚本里，无依赖、不联网，短语以明文存在 localStorage。

description.en: Open ChatGPT Dots in a full-width DSH page with Desktop startup preload, retained page state across panel switches, bilingual theme-aware controls, refresh and external-browser access. Optional login persistence (DSH Desktop only): a Settings button backs up and patches the browser-partition code in DSH Desktop's app.asar (Restore undoes it); it needs a full DSH restart, must be re-applied after a DSH upgrade, and is refused on code-signed macOS builds.
description.zh: 在 DSH 全幅页面使用 ChatGPT Dots，支持 Desktop 启动预加载、切换面板保留网页状态、中英文主题工具栏、刷新和外部浏览器打开。可选的登录保持（仅 DSH Desktop）：设置页按钮会先备份、再修改 DSH Desktop 安装目录里 app.asar 的浏览器分区代码（可「恢复原版」），需完全重启 DSH，DSH 升级后须重新应用；带系统代码签名的 macOS 应用会被拒绝。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that cuts token usage by projecting tool receipts (truncate + locator + spill) and substituting repeated read-only results deterministically, with a shadow-mode admission ledger and a same-origin settings page for status, scope and rollback

Local-first workbench plugin that turns the AI coding agents already running on your machine (ZCode, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, DSH, WorkBuddy) into an observable, accountable team — six-source read-only session observation with a transcript reader and dispatch prompts, commit/session-to-task attribution via branch or marker conventions, a kanban with evidence timelines, daily/weekly reports, plus MCP server, webhook and IM integrations. Zero third-party runtime dependencies and credentials read from git config at runtime, never written to disk. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 本机优先的工作台插件，把已经跑在你机器上的 AI 编码智能体（ZCode、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、DSH、WorkBuddy）变成一支可观测、可问责的团队——六源只读会话观测（全文阅读器 + 派工词）、按分支/标记约定将提交与会话自动归因到任务、带证据时间轴的看板、日报/周报，另有 MCP Server、Webhook 与 IM 通知集成。零第三方运行时依赖，凭据运行时从 git config 读取、永不落盘。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DeepSeek Harness model provider over the official ACP protocol — T3-Code-style, Gemini whitelist, approval bridge
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity CLI 接进 DeepSeek Harness 当模型供应商，支持 Gemini 白名单和审批桥接。

description.en: dsh余额预警
description.zh: 在输入框上方常驻显示 DeepSeek 余额和赠金，对话后自动刷新，余额吃紧时用插画提醒你。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 更好的语音输入：DeepSeek 原生 ASR、自动 AI 优化、光标回填与长录音恢复。复用宿主凭据和模型，配置 Key 后即插即用。
description.zh: 说话就能输入，DeepSeek 原生语音识别加 AI 自动润色，长录音也不怕丢。

description.en: DSH 编程智能体运行时插件，借鉴 Claude 任务编排机制，Codex 五段式契约层层推进，Pro 分析需求、编排任务，Flash 子智能体去干活，确保任务交付质量和 Token 价值最大化。A coding-agent runtime for DSH: it borrows Claude's task-orchestration mechanism and advances stage by stage through Codex's five-stage contract...
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Pro 负责拆解需求、编排任务，Flash 子智能体分头执行，帮你把编程任务稳稳交付。

description.en: Adds a Ctrl+F find panel to the conversation: lists matches with context, highlights every match in place, and jumps to the exact position via Previous, Next, or clicking a result.
description.zh: 在会话中按 Ctrl+F 打开查找面板：列出匹配项及上下文，全部匹配原文高亮，上一处、下一处或点击结果精确跳转到对应位置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏图表工坊：50 种编辑级图表模板，填内容后直接生成单文件 HTML 图表。
description.zh: 在侧栏挑个图表模板、填好内容，就能直接生成可发布的单文件 HTML 图表。

description.en: Plug-in external CLI Agent runtimes (Codex, Antigravity, Claude Code, TRAE CLI) for DeepSeek Harness (Desktop & Web)
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面端和网页端直接接入 Codex、Claude Code 等外部命令行 AI 助手，随插随用。

description.en: DSH-绝区零极简风格主题皮肤/Fairy Ⅲ H.D.D skin for DeepSeek Harness, with light/dark theme check
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 界面换成《绝区零》Fairy 的 H.D.D 终端皮肤，带开机动画和明暗主题切换。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a capped always-on profile plus silent recall over facts and real session history.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记住你的身份、项目和纠正，随时自动回忆。

description.en: Checks Epic Games, GOG and Steam for limited-time free games, attempts to claim them with saved browser logins, and marks owned or manual games separately. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 检查 Epic Games、GOG、Steam 的限时免费游戏，使用已保存的浏览器登录尝试入库，并单独标记已在库中或需要手动确认的游戏。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH plugin that passes official Gemini API parameters (safety thresholds, X-Server-Timeout, serviceTier, generationConfig…) on the native google route, with a config panel on the plugin detail page. | 为 DSH 的 Gemini 请求透传 Google 官方参数（安全阈值、超时时长、serviceTier 等），插件详情页内提供配置面板。
description.zh: 给 DSH 原生 google 路由补上 Gemini 官方 API 参数透传，还能在插件详情页配置。

description.en: GUI automation primitives for DeepSeek Harness on macOS: OCR with point coordinates, click-by-text, checkbox state verification, and a cross-session lesson notebook.
description.zh: 让 macOS 上的 GUI 自动化点得准：OCR 直接给出可点击坐标，按文字点击、核对勾选状态，还能跨会话记经验。

description.en: Lark (Feishu) multi-agent bridge, group governance, Dreaming offline memory & proactive assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Desktop & Web)
description.zh: 把飞书群变成多 Agent 协作入口，还能离线记忆、主动提醒，桌面和网页都能用。

description.en: Eight memory_* tools and one 1235-character prompt block over meow-memory's seven-layer SQLite: 0.977 hit@1 on a 146-entry corpus with 106 distractors, 3.3 ms per query at 1,200 entries, 8 tool schemas in 4,714 B of raw parameters.
description.zh: 8 个 memory_* 工具 + 一段 1235 字符常驻注入，主库是 meow 的七层 SQLite：146 条宽池（含 106 条干扰）照抄 hit@1 0.977、1200 条库单次检索 3.3ms、8 个工具参数共 4714 B。

description.en: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: embed the official Magpie Web GUI in the sidebar, with manual install, permanent GitHub mirror, in-DSH duplicate detection, gateway model registration and clean one-click uninstall.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接打开官方 Magpie 模型管理界面，还能把网关模型自动接进 DSH 模型选择器。

description.en: Available on npm as dsh-doudizhu-lan. Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium, hard, hell), so one or two people can still play a whole hand; the deal starts as soon as the three seats are filled. 54 cards in four suits, bidding of 1/2/3 or pass, the landlord takes the three bottom cards and holds 20, play runs clockwise, and the first-bid seat rotates clockwise between hands. The rule engine is pure and covers 11 legal shapes, with big joker > small joker > 2 > A > K down to 3, suits never compared, straights, pair-straights and planes excluding the 2s and the jokers, and a rocket that beats everything. The table itself is built to be read at a glance: three seat cards side by side in play order (you, then your next and previous seats) with role, hand count and a bar that runs out, one line that says whose hand is on the table and what would beat it, the bottom cards as text, an in-place play history that folds into a single summary line and unfolds into every trick including the passes, plus hint and auto-play buttons that pick the cheapest legal answer out of the local rule enumeration. Nicknames can be changed mid-hand (twelve characters, duplicates get a suffix). Computers run inside the authority and are handed only their own hand, the public record and the seat counts, so no hand can leak; the authority is the only place that decides which card ids leave it. Computers are driven by the room itself, so a one-person table keeps playing with nobody else on the LAN port. Humans have no turn timer, the collapsed floating pill can be dragged around the screen, and 179 unit tests pin the rules, the wire format, the theme tokens, the drag gesture, the history grouping and the computer seats.
description.zh: npm 包名 dsh-doudizhu-lan。三人局域网斗地主，从浮窗里打：一台机器用自己的端口开房，另外两家填六位房间码加地址入座。空位可以交给电脑补，四档强度（简单/中等/困难/地狱）随时可换，一个人或两个人也能打完整一局；座位坐满就发牌。54 张牌四种花色，叫分为 1/2/3 或不叫，地主拿三张底牌共 20 张，顺时针出牌，下局首叫位顺时针轮换。规则引擎为纯函数，覆盖 11 种合法牌型，大王 > 小王 > 2 > A > K 直到 3，花色不参与比较，顺子、连对与飞机不含 2 和王，王炸最大。牌桌本身按「一眼看懂」来做：三张座位卡按出牌顺序并排（我、下家、上家），带身份、剩余张数和一条会走空的进度条；一行说清台面上是谁的牌、要压过什么；底牌以文字贴在右侧；出牌历史贴在牌桌上，默认折成一行摘要，展开就是每一轮谁出了什么、谁不出；另有提示与帮我出两个按钮，从本地规则枚举里挑最省牌力的一手。昵称随时可改（十二字以内，重名自动加后缀）。电脑跑在权威那台机器里，只拿得到自己的手牌、公开的出牌记录与各家张数，因此看不到别人的手牌；权威服务是唯一决定哪些牌能离开它的地方。电脑由房间本身驱动，所以一个人加两台电脑的单机桌在没有别人连局域网端口时也照样打完；真人没有回合计时，收起后的药丸可以拖到屏幕任意位置，179 个单元测试钉住规则、传输格式、主题 token、拖动手势、历史分组与电脑座位。

description.en: Agent artifact library: new files land in the library automatically, edits to existing files wait in a pending queue for confirmation, and reads pin the version the agent saw. Ships an artifacts index built from session logs, a text and code preview with in-document search, and optional two-way mirroring to Tencent COS, S3-compatible storage or WebDAV with COS pre-signed share links. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
